scripts.test:ios: cd ElpriserIOS && xcodegen generate && DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer xcodebuild test -project Elpriser.xcodeproj -scheme Elpriser -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro' -only-testing:ElpriserTests CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
scripts.test:unit: node test-shelly-script.mjs && node test-forecast-chart.mjs && node test-zone-intro.mjs && node test-forecast-tariff.mjs
scripts.test:gate: node test-static.js && node --test test-api.mjs test-golden.mjs && npm run --silent test:unit
scripts.test:ci: npm run test:gate && node test.js && node test-regressions.js && node test-e2e.js
scripts.deploy: npm run test:gate && bash scripts/build-dist.sh && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=elpriser-org && (node scripts/indexnow.mjs || true) && npm run test:smoke
